title: Run a small Python snippet in the sandbox
notes: Worker/Planner-only — NOT on the Chat-agent surface. Tool calls from inside the sandbox route through the permission engine.

title: Paginate a list tool via tool_call() and aggregate the result
notes: tool_call(name, args) routes through the full permission engine (no security hole opened), returns a dict, and raises RuntimeError on denial or error. Set `result` in the script namespace to control what's returned to the LLM — this is the canonical shape for a pagination loop or multi-entity join that would otherwise take N separate tool calls.
